items.title: Kyru at Vintage Vintage Vintage DC
items.description: Kyru, a Virginia-based specialty cafe pop-up, serves matcha and cafe drinks inside the Vintage Vintage Vintage vintage shop near Union Market. Kyru ran the same collab in November, so expect a small drink menu and a browse through the racks.
items.notes: MATO lists Sat 2 Jan 2027 with the venue but no time and no street address; start time 11:00 is a PLACEHOLDER. Address is the shop's address from a web search (shop listed at 1348 4th St NE), not from the MATO page. Kyru's Nov 2026 pop-up at the same shop is on instagram.com/p/Df5yacRpXrJ.

items.title: Matcha Walk, first Longevity Philly event
items.description: A Sunday-after-Thanksgiving meetup at Matcha Panda Cafe: meet for matcha, short welcome, then an easy flat walk on the Schuylkill River Trail with a talk on matcha. Free to join; you buy your own drink.
items.notes: kind: meetup/class, not a pop-up; matcha is bought at the existing cafe. Date, time and address are on the Luma page, so it would be confirmed if it counted as a pop-up. Include only if meetups are wanted.

items.brand: Partea NYC x Eve Beauty Koreatown
items.title: Eve Beauty Black Friday matcha pop-up
items.description: Eve Beauty's first matcha pop-up, with freshly served matcha from Partea NYC while you shop Black Friday deals in the Koreatown store.
items.notes: Snippet says first-ever Matcha Pop-Up for Black Friday; date inferred as Fri 27 Nov 2026, time is a placeholder, no street address in the snippet. Not found on any other page. Needs a human check.
